# wavesurfer.js 7.12.12 (BSD-3-Clause)

`wavesurfer.esm.js`, `regions.esm.js` and `timeline.esm.js` are `dist/wavesurfer.esm.js`,
`dist/plugins/regions.esm.js` and `dist/plugins/timeline.esm.js` of npm `wavesurfer.js@7.12.12`
(https://www.npmjs.com/package/wavesurfer.js, tarball sha1 f402d88f56091d09e045c98f48075859b37719dd;
source https://github.com/katspaugh/wavesurfer.js). `LICENSE` is the package's BSD-3-Clause licence.
Unmodified. Used by `experiments/build_player.py` for the waveform, the regions (A-B loop, speed regions)
and the time ruler; the audio itself is played by the page's own engine through a media adapter.
